candidate_workaround: Complete the focused recovery witness, refresh all authoritative and derived negative and Method Flow counts, then run the aggregate test selection.
failure_signature: An aggregate test rerun starts before generated negative totals and Method Flow witness parity are refreshed after a new retained failure.
recurrence_guard: Before aggregate reruns, compare authoritative failure count, derived total, and Method Flow fail and pass witness counts.
rollback: Stop the aggregate rerun, retain its failed assertions, and return to the last consistent generated ledger set.
scope_boundary: Count and witness synchronization only; no broader evidence or authority claim.
title: Refresh derived failure mirrors before aggregate rerun
trigger_preconditions: A new operational negative or witness has been added since the last generated evidence build.
